connector.name: Tribal
connector.registryDescription: Self-hosted semantic memory over MCP for an engineering team's tacit knowledge. Needs Postgres.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image tribal:0.4.1. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tribal-memory account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: TRIBAL_DATABASE__URL
env.description: Postgres (pgvector) connection string. Tribal is self-hosted; you provide the database. The supported, complete deployment is docker-compose.yml.

env.name: TRIBAL_PROJECT_REMOTE
env.description: First-run only: the git remote that identifies the project bootstrapped on first start.

env.name: TRIBAL_PROJECT_NAME
env.description: First-run only: the name of the project bootstrapped on first start.

env.name: TRIBAL_SERVER__TRANSPORT
env.description: Containerised transport: http or sse. The Docker image does not serve stdio; install the binary for stdio.

env.name: TRIBAL_SERVER__BIND_ADDRESS
env.description: Address the server binds inside the container. Must be 0.0.0.0 (not the loopback default) for the published port to be reachable.

env.name: TRIBAL_PUBLIC_MCP_URL
env.description: The URL clients use to reach the server (for example http://127.0.0.1:8725/mcp). Needed for OAuth dynamic client registration once the server binds a routable interface.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional; only if an ingest or retrieval stage is configured to use OpenAI (defaults target a local Ollama).

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Optional; only if a stage is configured to use Anthropic.
